build_tokenizer: build a tokenizer using build_tokenizer with name bytes sp tiktoken or mock and an optional model path
encode_text_with_byte_tokenizer: encode a string to byte tokens using ByteTokenizer encode with optional BOS and EOS tokens
decode_tokens_with_sentencepiece: decode token IDs back to text using SentencePieceTokenizer decode with a loaded SentencePiece model
get_token_offsets_tiktoken: get token substrings and byte offsets from text using TikTokenTokenizer get_token_offsets for evaluation
encode_long_text_tiktoken: encode long text in chunks using TikTokenTokenizer encode which splits input at 400k char boundaries
